title: Where the project stands
text: Retinue went public yesterday: the framework (113 files, CI green), this chamber, a reference deployment, and the qlever-dir indexer are live under the retinue-os organization, MIT-licensed, with a fresh history scrubbed of personal data. Nothing has been announced anywhere yet — no social accounts exist, and creating them is the owner's next move. Until then the work is groundwork: keeping this dashboard honest, answering anything that arrives, and drafting the triple-store walkthrough that will be the first real story.
